title: Invoices created before the release export as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the production test account.
  • Have a CSV export of the invoice list taken on production shortly before the release, kept for comparison.
custom_steps:
1. Export the invoice list to CSV.
  2. Open the CSV file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A CSV file downloads.

Step 2:

  • Every invoice created before the release has the same Customer, Terms and every other value as in the export taken before the release.
  • The only change is the new last column, "Service Customer", blank on those rows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12321 (Story 19, IBS, invoice export and Public API)

  • S19-N2: “Invoices created before this release export exactly as before.”
  • S19-N1: “"Service Customer" is blank when the invoice bills its own customer.”
  • Feature Overview, Release day: “The invoice CSV export gains a last column, "Service Customer", blank on every invoice billed to its own customer (Story 19).”
  • Feature Overview, Release day: “Nothing is migrated. Every existing work order, part sale and invoice already has one customer in both roles, so every total, balance, report and document matches the day before.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs records made on production before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
